title: Coordinate descent beyond PR94: conditional κ = 5.279109590448e-5
body:
A small coordinate refinement beyond #94 gives conditional **κ = 329944349403/6250000000000000 = 5.279109590448×10⁻⁵**, about **0.000299% above #94** and **0.000358% above #93**. Exact bit saving: **52793882951577/10¹⁸**. This is a small finite gain, not a breakthrough or practical speedup.

Starting with #93's complete physical words, reverse coordinates 0 through 3 at h23 and exchange 5/6 at h25. The h25 change independently matches Maxime Fleury's #94. The additional h23 reversal supplies this increment. Roles remain **26,387 / 34,772**, physical width **130,417,912**, total recursive rank **74,988,452,500**. Every source/frame/output/scatter label is transported; all slot operations and paid copy, endpoint, cleanup and growth charges remain intact.

**Full verification passed** on `ea640ec01daf16ebe9d3d0a6ca9e47bd7f8b7dd8`: 92 isolated test modules, 20 historical patch checks, parent and own six-control suites, and fresh complete producer/profile regeneration. All 54 GitHub checks passed on that research commit. The run completed at 2026-10-08 23:11:14 UTC in 3,814.48 seconds, with no source drift. See `research/aligned-coordinate-descent/validation.json` for evidence hashes. Only the receipt and status documentation changed afterward. The focused gate passed independently in **155.18 seconds**, including independent parent-chain regeneration, byte comparisons, ordinary and arbitrary-dirty replay in both orientations, complete fresh CRT profiles, six controls, two rational moment implementations, both next-grid exclusions, 47 strict constraints and seven margins. There are **2,752 source pins**. The exact comparison rejects the complete paid lists of #93 and #94 at the new saving. Every #94 paid-profile field also agrees with our independently checked parent h23 and selected h25 profiles; no regeneration of #94's own producer is claimed.

The bounded Daytona search ran 32 workers, four move families with four seeds in each dimension and 16 proposals per worker. All workers passed. Floating-point scores guided selection; all **289** complete selected-axis combinations, including the parent, were compared with exact rational arithmetic. Finite search does not prove global optimality.

```sh
python3 research/aligned-coordinate-descent/verify.py --regenerate
python3 research/aligned-coordinate-descent/test_controls.py
make verify
```

The coordinate-transport argument and complete paid profile are in `research/aligned-coordinate-descent/PROOF.md`. All inherited analytic, ordered residual compiler, uniform all-size recursion, scalar overhead, routing, prime selection, exact recovery and fixed-tape hypotheses remain. The inherited Lean companion concerns #91's values, not this new exponent.
